sounds.title: Car Braking
sounds.creator: Universfield
sounds.direction: Candidate for sustained slipping tyres. Audition and find a clean loop before integration; fade with slip strength.

sounds.title: Car Engine Roaring
sounds.creator: DRAGON-STUDIO
sounds.direction: Audition as a throttle accent. Retain the existing engine synthesis for continuous RPM and gear response unless a seamless recording loop works better.
sounds.credit: Car Engine Roaring — DRAGON-STUDIO, via Pixabay.

sounds.title: Glass Shattering
sounds.creator: DRAGON-STUDIO
sounds.direction: Reserve for a window breaking completely; retain the small synthesized crack for ordinary damage.

sounds.title: Splat Sounds
sounds.creator: XpMonster
sounds.direction: Audition and trim individual wet transients for paint impacts. Keep each hit brief so rapid fire stays readable.

paintball_direction: Audition single-shot pneumatic marker recordings before replacing SFX.gun; avoid firearm reports and long automatic bursts.
credits_placement: Always credit recordings when installed. Show each exact title and creator with its source link in the visible front/setup cover credits beneath the title content. Include the Pixabay Content License link. Do not hide credits on the back or in a disclosure. Do not label candidates as used assets.
